description: Binding site site_003 has visible weak ligand-like density but generate_alpha_masks emitted zero segments at the default threshold of 2.5σ.

expected_decision.rationale: Density is below the current threshold but volume + position suggest a real but weak ligand. Loosen the alpha-mask to capture it before any docking can happen.

notes: Directly calling generate_alpha_masks with reduced threshold_sigma is also acceptable.
